Class MapLoader

java.lang.Object
MapLoader
public class MapLoader extends Object
Parses a CSV map file into a 2-D tile array, a list of Trainer NPCs, and a list of TerrainObjects.

Tile values in the CSV:

  • 0 – walkable grass
  • 1 – tree (solid)
  • 2 – rock (solid)
  • 3 – pokeball (non-solid collectible)
  • 5 – exit tile
  • 8 – trainer spawn (replaced with 0 in the tile array)
  • 9 – tall grass (wild encounter trigger)
